values.title: Migrations
values.summary: How Tessera plans, reviews and applies schema changes without downtime.
values.body:
## Planning a migration

When you change `schema.ts`, Tessera compares it with the target environment and plans the SQL needed to get there. You always see the plan before anything runs.

```
npx tessera migrate plan --env staging
```

## Applying a migration

- Open a pull request with your schema change.

- CI runs `tessera migrate plan` and posts the plan as a comment.

- After merge, run `tessera migrate apply --env production` or let the deploy hook do it.

## Zero-downtime changes

Tessera splits risky changes into safe steps. Adding a `notNull` column, for example, is applied as add-nullable, backfill, then add the constraint.

Rolling back

Every migration has a generated down step. Run `tessera migrate rollback --to <id>` to revert to a known point.
